data.name: hololive Dreams
data.detailed_description:
The official hololive rhythm game and RPG -- hololive Dreams -- is now on Steam!

Centered around rhythm gameplay, the game includes a variety of content such as theme park development and mini-games!

Over 50 hololive members make an appearance, and the initial tracklist will include 150+ songs!

A game that both hololive fans and newcomers can enjoy. The way you play is entirely up to you!

▼A full-fledged rhythm game▼

Enjoy a full-on rhythm game based on official music videos and live concert videos!

The game features a "Create Chart" function, allowing you to make and share your own original charts!

・Extremely challenging, hardcore charts for dedicated players!

・Charts filled with love for the talents!

・Fun and quirky charts that everyone can enjoy together!

And more! You are the limit!

Play with charts created by players from all around the world, and experience endless fun!

Even if you're not good at rhythm games, you can enjoy it worry-free with the auto-play feature!

Aim for higher scores by training and organizing your party!

▼A wide variety of over 150 songs at launch!▼

From hololive songs to cover songs!

The lineup includes everything from the latest hits to classic tracks!

hololive songs

・BIBBIDIBA

・Shiny Smily Story

・BLUE CLAPPER

And more!

Cover songs

・The Brave

・Megitsune

・Watashi no Ichiban Kawaiitokoro

And more!

▼The game is set in a theme park▼

hololive members have arrived to an uninhabited island somewhere in the ocean.

And you will need to team up with them to develop your very own dream theme park!

Play rhythm games and mini-games to complete quests and expand your theme park!

Also, by completing holomem Quests, you can unlock and add more playable talents!

Unlock your favorite holomem and build your dream theme park!

Many facilities full of hololive’s unique charm will also take the stage!

Experience an original story unique to this game!

Aim to complete your dream theme park!

▼Mini-games. Solo or with everyone!▼

The game will include a variety of mini-games that can be enjoyed alone or with friends!

Have fun with everyone or compete against others!

Includes mini-games with simple controls, so even those who struggle with tricky actions can enjoy them!

A wide lineup ranging from casual games you can play in a short time, to challenging, hardcore games you'll want to keep replaying!

Earn rewards by playing, and use them to speed up the talent’s growth and theme park development!

++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
Powered by Live2D

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 11 64-bit
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen™ 3 2200G / Intel® Core™ i3-8100
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Radeon™ RX 470 / NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 970
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: There have been reports of false positives in some antivirus software, where certain files that are part of this application (e.g., usrdrv017964.sys) are mistakenly detected as malware or threat. The detected files are part of a security protection component used to prevent unauthorized modification or misuse of this app. They do not contain any viruses, malware, or other harmful programs. Rest assured that the application is safe to use. If the files are removed or quarantined by your antivirus software, the app may no longer start correctly. Should this occur, please follow the steps below. ・Restore the files using your antivirus software and add them to the exclusion (or exception) list. If the files have been deleted, run "Verify Integrity of Game Files" from your Steam Library to restore them.
